**Security: pass-with-notes** at `4a0bc62b932da3f2783dbb21b32f7bb0413b73e4`.

Both remaining LOW findings at `5021882` are closed in the scoped repair. No remaining high-confidence proposed-data-only bypass found for the reviewed exemption/coverage-identity boundaries.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 0 | None | N/A | N/A | No remaining reportable finding in the repair | N/A |

Repeated required sections and row IDs produce findings before coverage/exemption processing (`harness/scripts/coverage-check.ts:102-133`). Later duplicate rows are skipped, retaining the first unfinished child for umbrella evaluation. Findings remain accumulated; any finding makes the CLI unsuccessful (`330-337`).

Runtime exemption validation rejects invalid, duplicate and outside-baseline entries (`149-174`). Each checker-baseline address must have a matching valid JSON entry and refer to an existing uncovered obligation (`226-251`). Missing rows, missing JSON membership and covered targets fail. Deleted-row-plus-deleted-JSON no longer passes with the constant retained. The production entry uses the checker constant, not proposed JSON, as its baseline.

Exact membership and filesystem-derived document addresses prevent the reviewed normalization/collision bypasses. Owner/reason edits cannot broaden eligibility. Retiring an approved entry requires explicit removal from both locations.

Controls cover missing/covered/mismatched negatives and explicit-removal positives (`harness/scripts/coverage-check.test.ts:122-147`). Direct section arrays cover duplicates and preserve the unfinished-child umbrella finding (`232-285`). The duplicate-requirement fixture uses a delivered ID, not an approved exemption; the unconditional identity guard also applies to approved IDs.

Earlier required-input failure guards remain intact. The four-file repair introduces no privacy disclosure, safety weakening or shipped-template/pin changes.

**Proof:** exact-head CI [42397453707](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42397453707), attempt 1, passed all four jobs; Node 22 and Node 24 each executed 18 coverage-check tests. Mutation evidence remains author-reported, not independently rerun. F104/C20 ddocs remains UNAVAILABLE: no full-schema validation or historical/implementation provenance proof is claimed. Changing authoritative requirement definitions is not automatically treated as privilege escalation. No local builds/tests, credentials, role edits, live probes or product changes.
